title: My Heart -- Ah! My Goddess OP
lyrics_plain:
CVS Ver5.04 Createdoa`jq
Love is not something that occurs
Just because I am close to you.
Make a puzzle out of it;
It will not be solved, it's too hard to do.
In the Spring, we went to the sea,
Wearing clothes made for Summer's charms.
Gently wrap your shirt on me;
Let me warm up within its arms.
"My Heart" I cannot say to you,
"Please, kiss me, I need you to."
"Day Dream" My dream grows larger and it
Disappears, soaring high, in the sky.
It's true that any girl can feel happiness,
Emotions full of pure delight,
Once they fall into boundless love
And shine with light so bright.
Even if tears would flow from my swollen eyes,
Or if my heart aches in my chest,
If it is all because of you,
I will not be depressed.
I want to keep a secret and
Feel the guilty suffering.
I know all the news with you,
But pretend I don't know of anything.
Even if my heart pounds in Fall,
Or in Winter I'm feeling blue,
Everything will be okay
If my precious love bears its fruit.
"Your Heart" I want to know for sure.
"Believe" Your fingers' touch, so pure.
"True Love" This is the first time that I
Blushed so much, cheeks became set aflame.
The time a girl can say that she fell in love,
She's able to be beautiful.
There's no need to put lipstick on,
Love makes it natural.
Even if she can't sleep when she goes to bed,
She lives a life of endless dreams.
She is full of the joys of love
Which overflow in streams.
It's true that any girl can feel happiness,
Emotions full of pure delight.
If she's armed with the shield of love,
She'll never lose a fight.
Even if tears would flow from her swollen eyes,
Or if her heart aches in her chest,
If it is all because of you,
She'll be her gentlest.
